ritornello-install @VERSION@

Take the file for your system, extract it, and run it:

    ./ritornello-install --host account@device

The newest installer is always at
`https://github.com/skerdudou/ritornello/releases/download/installer/<file>`;
this release is the numbered, permanent copy of version @VERSION@. The
installer installs the newest Ritornello release by itself and tells you when
a newer installer than this one exists. It never updates itself.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the archives of this release, if you want to check a
download.

**What changed in this installer:** to be written by whoever cuts the
release, on the release page, once it is published.
